api_well_number.description: Fourteen-digit API well number assigned by BSEE; unique per borehole in the inventory.
api_well_number.title: API Well Number

borehole_status_code.description: Borehole status code as published (e.g. COM = completed, PA = permanently abandoned, TA = temporarily abandoned, ST = shut-in, CNL = cancelled).
borehole_status_code.title: Borehole Status Code

borehole_status_date.description: Date of the published borehole status, YYYY-MM-DD, when present.
borehole_status_date.title: Borehole Status Date

bottom_area_code.description: OCS area code of the bottom-hole location.
bottom_area_code.title: Bottom Area Code

bottom_block_number.description: OCS block number of the bottom-hole location, as published.
bottom_block_number.title: Bottom Block Number

bottom_hole_total_md_ft.description: Bottom-hole total measured depth in feet, when published. The source masks some depths as "*****"; those are delivered as null.
bottom_hole_total_md_ft.title: Bottom-Hole Total MD (ft)

bottom_lease_number.description: OCS lease number of the bottom-hole location, when present.
bottom_lease_number.title: Bottom Lease Number

completions_count.description: Number of completion records the source publishes for this well (0 when none).
completions_count.title: Completions

field_name_code.description: Bottom-hole field name code as published (e.g. "MC524").
field_name_code.title: Field Name Code

latest_completion_date.description: Completion date of the most recent completion record, YYYY-MM-DD; empty when the well has no completion records.
latest_completion_date.title: Latest Completion Date

latest_completion_status_code.description: Status code of the most recent completion record, as published (e.g. POW, GSI, OSI); empty when the well has no completion records.
latest_completion_status_code.title: Latest Completion Status Code

operator_name.description: Operator (company) name as published. Operators in the source are companies; no individual names or contact details are included.
operator_name.title: Operator

production_intervals.description: All production interval codes recorded for the well, separated by '; ', as published; empty when none.
production_intervals.title: Production Intervals

region_code.description: BSEE OCS region code: G (Gulf of Mexico), P (Pacific), Y (Alaska), A (Atlantic).
region_code.title: Region Code

region_name.description: BSEE OCS region name for the region code.
region_name.title: Region

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this Actor retrieved the record (ISO 8601).
scraped_at.title: Retrieved At

source_endpoint.description: Official BSEE raw data file (APIRawData.zip) the record was retrieved from.
source_endpoint.title: Source Endpoint

surface_area_code.description: OCS area code of the surface location (e.g. "MC" = Mississippi Canyon, "GC" = Green Canyon).
surface_area_code.title: Surface Area Code

surface_block_number.description: OCS block number of the surface location, as published.
surface_block_number.title: Surface Block Number

surface_lease_number.description: OCS lease number of the surface location (e.g. "G33161"), when present.
surface_lease_number.title: Surface Lease Number

total_depth_date.description: Date total depth was reached, YYYY-MM-DD, when present.
total_depth_date.title: Total Depth Date

well_name.description: Well name as published in the API List (typically the well designation, e.g. "001").
well_name.title: Well Name

well_name_suffix.description: Well name suffix as published (e.g. "ST00BP01" for a sidetrack / bypass designation), when present.
well_name_suffix.title: Well Name Suffix

well_spud_date.description: Date drilling began (spud date), YYYY-MM-DD, when present.
well_spud_date.title: Spud Date

well_type_code.description: Well type code as published in the source data (e.g. D, E, C).
well_type_code.title: Well Type Code
